description_en: Writes or updates UModel content in batches
description_zh: 批量写入/更新 UModel 内容
name: UpsertSourceModel

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. The model belongs to the project, and each project corresponds to one model
parameters.help_zh: Project 名称。模型归属于该 Project，一个 Project 对应一个模型
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The list of elements to create or update. Elements with the exact same type, domain, and name are replaced entirely rather than merged field by field. This operation only writes elements and does not delete any elements
parameters.help_zh: 要新增或更新的元素列表。类型、域、名称完全相同的元素会被整条替换，而不是逐字段合并；本接口只写入，不会删除任何元素
parameters.name: elements

status.description_en: The status of the operation. If the write operation is successful, success is returned. A single model can contain up to 50,000 elements, and a single request can contain up to 2,000 elements. If the limit is exceeded, no elements are written in the current request
status.description_zh: 调用结果状态。写入成功时固定返回 success。单个模型最多 50000 个元素、单次请求最多 2000 个元素，超限时本次不会写入任何元素

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. The collection of elements to write in this request. This parameter cannot be empty
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。本次要写入的元素集合，不能为空
v1_body_parameters.name: body
